property_summary: After a successful initialize, the pool's public baseToken() getter must equal the _baseToken address passed in, for every admissible input; the mutant always stores address(0), so it violates this rule whenever _baseToken != address(0).

After a successful initialize, C stores baseToken as exactly the _baseToken argument (and stores nft separately), so for any two distinct addresses the invariant baseToken == _baseToken != _nft holds; the mutant sets baseToken to _nft, violating it whenever _baseToken != _nft.
After initialize is called with any _baseToken, c.baseToken() must equal the supplied _baseToken; the mutant never sets baseToken, so it stays address(0) for any nonzero _baseToken.

For any inputs, after a successful initialize(_nft, ...) the pool's public nft getter must return exactly the _nft value passed in; the mutant never assigns it, so c.nft() stays address(0) and differs for any nonzero _nft.

After initialize(_baseToken,_nft,...) completes, the contract's public nft getter must equal the _nft argument passed in, for every admissible (nonzero) _nft; the mutant stores address(0) instead, so nft() returns the zero address for any nonzero _nft.

For any admissible inputs, after a successful initialize the pool's nft getter returns exactly the _nft argument passed in; the mutant stores _baseToken instead, so it violates this for any input where _baseToken != _nft.
m_diagnostic: testFuzz_property(address,address,uint16): nft must be set to the _nft argument

property_summary: For any admissible initialization parameters, after initialize succeeds the pool's changeFee getter must equal the supplied _changeFee; the mutant never stores it, so changeFee stays 0 and disagrees whenever _changeFee != 0.

After any successful initialize, the stored changeFee must equal the _changeFee argument passed in; the mutant stores the _feeRate argument instead, so for any input with _changeFee != uint56(_feeRate) (e.g. _feeRate <= 5000 and _changeFee different) the stored changeFee diverges.

After initialize(_baseToken,_nft,_vb,_vn,_changeFee,...), the pool's stored changeFee always equals the _changeFee argument; the mutant stores _changeFee+1, so for any _changeFee < 2^56-1 c.changeFee() != _changeFee.
For any admissible initialize call, the stored feeRate always equals the supplied _feeRate; the mutant leaves feeRate at 0, violating this whenever _feeRate != 0.
After any successful initialize call, c.feeRate() must equal the supplied _feeRate parameter; the buggy version stores 1 instead, so it violates this for any _feeRate != 1.
